page.layout: One printed page: a digitiser's cover sheet with e-rara logo, title block, and terms-of-use notices; no running text, no margins. Only the digitiser's banner, logo and links are present, which are not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is the digitiser's cover sheet for e-rara (Zentralbibliothek Zürich, shelf mark 5.56,2), not a printed page of the 1572 book. Its banner, logo, persistent link and terms-of-use notices are left out per the rules. The title block reads: "In posteriorem D. Pauli apostoli ad Corinthios epistolam homiliae", Gwalther, Rudolf, Tiguri, anno 1572. The page carries no page number, running head, catchword or signature.
